# Quickly calculate fraction-in-peak for genome peaks..
```{r}
# PLOT THEME
paletteCW <- c(
  Pink_CW      = "#EC008C",
  Teal_CW      = "#008C8C",
  Charcoal_CW  = "#2E2E2E",
  LimeGreen_CW = "#9BC53D",
  SoftOrange_CW= "#F4A261",
  Purple_CW    = "#7B2CBF"
)

themeCW <- function(baseSize = 6) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = baseSize) %+replace%
    theme(
      # panel
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, colour = "black", size = 0.5),
      
      # axes lines/ticks/text
      axis.line = element_blank(),                      # border handles the visual frame
      axis.ticks = element_line(size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.03, "in"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      
      # legend
      legend.key        = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = baseSize),
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      
      legend.key.size   = unit(0.2, "cm"),
      legend.spacing.y  = unit(1, "pt"),
      legend.margin     = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      legend.position = "top",
      
      # plot text & margins
      plot.title = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = baseSize, colour = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5, unit = "pt"),
      
      aspect.ratio=1
    )
}


######################################
# Function to save plots in my preferred size
plotSave <- function(plotVar, fileName, outSave=outDir,w=1.5,h=1.5){
  ggsave(
  filename = file.path(outSave,fileName),
  plot = plotVar,
  device = "pdf",
  width = w,
  height = h,
  units = "in"
  )
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse, quietly=TRUE)
library(ggplot2, quietly=TRUE)

macRoot <- "/Volumes/whipple_lab/Users/cwhilden/PROJECTS/THESIS/chapter2"


totalCounts<- read_csv(file.path(macRoot,"plots/Snord116_chimeras/Snord116_ChimerasRawPerClass.csv"))
  
data_repA <- read_csv(file.path(macRoot,"summaryFiles/peakSummaryFiles/iNeuron_A_Snord116genomePeaks.csv"))
data_repB <- read_csv(file.path(macRoot,"summaryFiles/peakSummaryFiles/iNeuron_B_Snord116genomePeaks.csv"))
probe<- read_csv(file.path(macRoot,"summaryFiles/peakSummaryFiles/Probe_Snord116genomePeaks.csv"))

```

Get total number of Snord116 genomic chimeras in each sample
```{r}
genomeTotal<-totalCounts%>%
  filter(target %in% c('other_counted','premRNA','psuedogene'))

col_sums <- genomeTotal %>%
  select(-...1, -target) %>%  # remove non-numeric columns
  summarise(across(everything(), sum, na.rm = TRUE))

```


Get fraction
```{r}
data_repA$fraction<-data_repA$`reads in CLIP`/col_sums$SSEXPT8_IP_A_S3_R1_001 
  
data_repB$fraction<-data_repB$`reads in CLIP`/col_sums$SSEXPT8_IP_B_S4_R1_001
probe$fraction<-probe$`reads in CLIP`/col_sums$`TDZ-7_S7_R1_001`


filterA<- data_repA %>%  filter(enriched_or_depleted == 'enriched',
         !(`Gene Type` %in% c('rRNA','snRNA','scaRNA')),
         log2_fold_change >= 1.5)

filterB <- data_repB%>%  filter(enriched_or_depleted == 'enriched',
        !(`Gene Type` %in% c('rRNA','snRNA','scaRNA')),
         log2_fold_change >= 1.5)


filterProbe <- probe%>%  filter(enriched_or_depleted == 'enriched',
        !(`Gene Type` %in% c('rRNA','snRNA','scaRNA')),
         log2_fold_change >= 1.5)


```


iNeuron Summary
```{r}
# Assuming you want to join filterA (RepA) with filterB (RepB):
join_A <- filterA %>%
  select(all_of(c('name','Gene Name',"Gene Type","fraction","log2_fold_change"))) %>%
  mutate(sample = 'iNeuron_RepA')

join_B <- filterB %>%
  select(all_of(c('name','Gene Name',"Gene Type","fraction","log2_fold_change"))) %>%
  mutate(sample = 'iNeuron_RepB')

# Join on the common columns: name, Gene Name, and Gene Type
iNeurons <- left_join(
  join_A,
  join_B,
  by = c('name', 'Gene Name', 'Gene Type'),
  suffix = c("_A", "_B")
)

write.csv(iNeurons,file.path(macRoot,"summaryFiles/iNeuron_GenomicPeaks_Enriched.csv"))

gene_type_counts <- iNeurons %>%
  count(`Gene Type`, name = "Count") %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))
```

```{r}
plot_data <- filterProbe %>%
  # Sort from highest enrichment to lowest
  arrange(desc(log2_fold_change)) %>%
  # Add a rank column (1 = highest enrichment)
  mutate(Rank = row_number())

# Identify the top 15 genes to label on the plot so it doesn't get cluttered
top_genes <- plot_data %>% head(20)

panel_a <- plot_data %>%
  # Count how many of each gene type there are
  count(`Gene Type`) %>%
  # Reorder the bars so the largest is on top
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(`Gene Type`, n), y = n, fill = `Gene Type`)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", width = 0.5) +
  # Add text labels at the end of the bars
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 4) +
  coord_flip() + # Make it horizontal
  labs(title = "A. Distribution of Peak Biotypes",
       x = "RNA Biotype",
       y = "Number of Enriched Peaks") +
  # Expand Y axis slightly so the text labels don't get cut off
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) + themeCW()

panel_a
outDir<-file.path(macRoot,"summaryFiles")
plotSave(panel_a,"ProbeEnriched_GenomeChimeras_BarPlot.pdf",h=2,w=4)
```

```{r}
panel_b <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Rank, y = log2_fold_change, color = `Gene Type`)) +
  # Add points
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  # Add labels to only the top 15 genes, repelled so they don't overlap
  geom_text_repel(data = top_genes, 
                  aes(label = `Gene Name`), 
                  size = 2, 
                  color = "black",
                  max.overlaps = Inf,       # <--- THIS FORCES ALL LABELS TO SHOW
                  box.padding = 0.5,
                  point.padding = 0.3,
                  min.segment.length = 0,
                  segment.color = "grey50") +
  labs(title = "Peak Enrichment Rank",
       x = "Peak Rank",
       y = expression("log"[2]*" Peak Fold Enrichment"),
       color = "RNA Biotype") + themeCW()

panel_b

plotSave(panel_b,"ProbeEnriched_Peaks_FoldEnrichScatter.pdf",w=3,h=3)
```
